items.prompt_en: A school pictograph uses one symbol for 5 students. If the cricket row has 7 symbols, how many students chose cricket?
items.prompt_hi: School ke pictograph mein ek symbol 5 students ko dikhata hai. Cricket ki row mein 7 symbols hain. Kitne students ne cricket chuna?

items.prompt_en: A bar graph shows 24 books borrowed on Monday and 37 on Tuesday. How many more books were borrowed on Tuesday?
items.prompt_hi: Bar graph mein Monday ko 24 aur Tuesday ko 37 books borrow hui hain. Tuesday ko kitni zyada books borrow hui?

items.prompt_en: A bell rings every 6 minutes and another every 8 minutes. They ring together now. After how many minutes will they next ring together?
items.prompt_hi: Ek bell har 6 minute aur doosri har 8 minute mein bajti hai. Abhi dono saath baji hain. Phir kitne minute baad saath bajengi?

items.prompt_en: What is the smallest prime number greater than 20?
items.prompt_hi: 20 se bada sabse chhota prime number kaunsa hai?

items.prompt_en: What is the greatest prime factor of 84?
items.prompt_hi: 84 ka sabse bada prime factor kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A rectangular badminton court is 13 m long and 6 m wide. What is its perimeter?
items.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular badminton court 13 m lamba aur 6 m chauda hai. Uska perimeter kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A rectangular school garden is 12 m long and 7 m wide. What is its area?
items.prompt_hi: School ka rectangular garden 12 m lamba aur 7 m chauda hai. Uska area kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A triangular flag has a base of 10 cm and a height of 8 cm. What is its area?
items.prompt_hi: Ek triangular flag ka base 10 cm aur height 8 cm hai. Uska area kya hai?

items.prompt_en: A recipe needs 3/4 cup of milk. How many quarter-cups of milk is that?
items.prompt_hi: Ek recipe mein 3/4 cup doodh chahiye. Yeh kitne quarter-cups doodh ke barabar hai?

items.prompt_en: Riya walked 5/4 km. How many whole kilometres did she walk before the remaining 1/4 km?
items.prompt_hi: Riya 5/4 km chali. Bache hue 1/4 km se pehle woh kitne poore kilometre chali thi?

items.prompt_en: A tank is 2/3 full. Write this as an equivalent fraction with denominator 12.
items.prompt_hi: Ek tank 2/3 bhara hai. Ise denominator 12 wale equivalent fraction mein likho.

items.prompt_en: Aman drank 1/4 litre of water in the morning and 2/4 litre later. How many litres did he drink altogether?
items.prompt_hi: Aman ne subah 1/4 litre aur baad mein 2/4 litre paani piya. Usne kul kitne litre paani piya?

items.prompt_en: A stadium has 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 seats in successive triangular rows. How many seats are in the next row?
items.prompt_hi: Stadium ki lagatar triangular rows mein 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 seats hain. Agli row mein kitni seats hongi?

items.prompt_en: A square of dots grows by adding a border each time: 1, 4, 9, 16 dots. How many dots are in the next square?
items.prompt_hi: Dots ka square har baar ek border jodne se badhta hai: 1, 4, 9, 16 dots. Agle square mein kitne dots honge?

items.prompt_en: Four equal square tiles are placed in one row, each sharing a full side with the next. How many tile sides form the outside boundary?
items.prompt_hi: Chaar barabar square tiles ek row mein hain; har tile agle tile ke saath poori side share karti hai. Bahari boundary mein kitni tile sides hain?

items.prompt_en: A torch beam starts at the torch and travels straight in one direction. Which geometric idea best models its path?
items.prompt_hi: Torch ki beam torch se shuru hokar seedhi ek disha mein jaati hai. Iska path kaunsi geometric idea sabse achchhi tarah dikhati hai?

items.prompt_en: A cyclist turns clockwise from facing north to facing east. Through how many degrees has the cyclist turned?
items.prompt_hi: Ek cyclist north ki taraf se clockwise mudkar east ki taraf dekhta hai. Woh kitne degrees muda?

items.prompt_en: A phone stand holds a phone at an angle of 120° to the tabletop. What type of angle is 120°?
items.prompt_hi: Phone stand par phone tabletop se 120° ka angle banata hai. 120° kis tarah ka angle hai?

items.prompt_en: A locker code reads the same forwards and backwards. Its first digit is 4, middle digit is 7, and it has three digits. What is the code?
items.prompt_hi: Ek locker code aage aur peeche se ek jaisa padhta hai. Pehla digit 4, beech ka 7 hai, aur code teen digits ka hai. Code kya hai?

items.prompt_en: In a number game, an odd number is multiplied by 3 and then 1 is added. What number follows 9?
items.prompt_hi: Ek number game mein odd number ko 3 se multiply karke 1 jodte hain. 9 ke baad kaunsa number aayega?

items.prompt_en: A school buys supplies for ₹498 and ₹703. Round each cost to the nearest hundred to estimate the total. What is the estimate?
items.prompt_hi: School ₹498 aur ₹703 ka samaan kharidta hai. Kul kharch ka andaza lagane ke liye har daam ko nearest hundred tak round karo. Andaza kya hai?

items.prompt_en: Students recorded how they travelled to school: bus, walk, cycle, bus, bus, walk, cycle, bus. How many students travelled by bus?
items.prompt_hi: Students ne school aane ka tareeka likha: bus, paidal, cycle, bus, bus, paidal, cycle, bus. Bus se kitne students aaye?

items.prompt_en: In a pictograph of library visitors, each star represents 5 visitors. Wednesday has 6 stars. How many visitors came on Wednesday?
items.prompt_hi: Library visitors ke pictograph mein har star 5 visitors dikhata hai. Wednesday ke saamne 6 stars hain. Us din kitne visitors aaye?

items.prompt_en: A bar graph shows books borrowed: Monday 12, Tuesday 18, Wednesday 15. How many more books were borrowed on Tuesday than Monday?
items.prompt_hi: Ek bar graph mein borrowed books dikhayi hain: Monday 12, Tuesday 18, Wednesday 15. Tuesday ko Monday se kitni zyada books li gayin?

items.prompt_en: A 3 m ribbon is cut into 4 equal pieces. What is the length of one piece in metres?
items.prompt_hi: 3 m ribbon ko 4 barabar tukdon mein kaata gaya. Ek tukde ki lambai metres mein kitni hai?

items.prompt_en: A runner completes 7/4 laps of a track. How many laps is that as a mixed fraction?
items.prompt_hi: Ek runner track ke 7/4 laps poore karta hai. Mixed fraction mein yeh kitne laps hain?

items.prompt_en: A recipe uses 3/4 cup of dal. Write this amount as an equivalent fraction with denominator 12.
items.prompt_hi: Ek recipe mein 3/4 cup dal lagti hai. Is matra ko denominator 12 wale equivalent fraction mein likho.

items.prompt_en: Meera walked 5/6 km and Kabir walked 3/4 km. How much farther did Meera walk, in kilometres?
items.prompt_hi: Meera 5/6 km aur Kabir 3/4 km chale. Meera kitne kilometres zyada chali?

items.prompt_en: A bottle holds 2 litres. It contains 5/8 litre of juice, then 3/4 litre is added. How much juice is in it now?
items.prompt_hi: Ek bottle mein 2 litres aa sakte hain. Usmein 5/8 litre juice hai, phir 3/4 litre aur dala gaya. Ab kitna juice hai?

adjudicated.note: 5/8 + 3/4 = 11/8 = 1 3/8; solver was right too, checker wrong: key correct

items.prompt_en: For a circle, Riya sets her compass opening to 4.5 cm. What will be the circle’s diameter?
items.prompt_hi: Circle banane ke liye Riya compass ko 4.5 cm kholti hai. Circle ka diameter kitna hoga?

items.prompt_en: Two schools are equally far from a bus stop and lie on opposite sides of it. Which construction locates the bus stop?
items.prompt_hi: Do schools bus stop se barabar door hain aur uske opposite sides par hain. Bus stop ki jagah kis construction se milegi?
items.answer: Find the midpoint of the segment joining the schools

options.text: Find the midpoint of the segment joining the schools
Draw a circle centred at either school
Extend the segment beyond one school
Draw a line perpendicular to the segment through either school

verified.solverAnswer: Find the midpoint of the segment joining the schools

items.prompt_en: A rectangular phone screen is longer than it is wide. How many lines of symmetry does its outline have?
items.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular phone screen ki lambai uski chaudai se zyada hai. Uski outline mein symmetry ki kitni lines hain?

items.prompt_en: A square floor tile is turned around its centre. What is the smallest positive angle that makes it look unchanged?
items.prompt_hi: Ek square floor tile ko uske centre ke around ghumaya gaya. Sabse chhota positive angle kya hai jisse woh pehle jaisa dikhe?

items.prompt_en: At dawn, the temperature is −3°C. By noon it rises 8°C. What is the temperature at noon?
items.prompt_hi: Subah taapmaan −3°C hai. Dopahar tak 8°C badhta hai. Dopahar ka taapmaan kya hai?

items.prompt_en: On a number line, a lift starts at floor −4 and moves up 7 floors. Which floor does it reach?
items.prompt_hi: Number line par lift floor −4 se shuru hoti hai aur 7 floors upar jaati hai. Woh kis floor par pahunchegi?

items.prompt_en: A team has a score of −6 points. It gains 11 points, then loses 3 points. What is its final score?
items.prompt_hi: Ek team ka score −6 points hai. Use 11 points milte hain, phir 3 points kat jaate hain. Antim score kya hai?
